verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents online corporation formation, including C corps, with state filing handled for you and free correction of filings it gets wrong. That covers the filing core of the story. The evidence never mentions Delaware specifically, bylaws, or initial board resolutions. Only adjacent items appear: AI-generated meeting minutes, and a 150+ legal-document library listed on the LLC page. Missing for 10: explicit Delaware incorporation support, bylaws drafting, initial board consent/organizational resolutions, independent or hands-on corroboration of a full startup incorporation flow.
